summary: Dawan Africa ayaa sheegtay in Jen. Barise, oo la magacaabay 25-kii Oktoobar, uu xilka kala wareegay Jen. Madey Nuuray Sheekh Ufurow. Barise ayaa horay xilkan u hayay 2019 ilaa 2020.
title: Jen. Maxamed Cali Barise oo si rasmi ah ula wareegay xilka Taliyaha Ciidamada Xoogga
